name: DNS Resolution Failure
description: Host cannot resolve domain names but direct IP access works.
error_message:
ping: google.com: Temporary failure in name resolution
curl: (6) Could not resolve host: google.com
symptoms: All domain name lookups fail. Pinging 8.8.8.8 directly works. System updated yesterday.
expected_behavior: DNS resolution should work for all domain names.
attempted_actions: Rebooted once. Checked network cable — physically connected.
additional_context: This is a desktop workstation on a home LAN with a router at 192.168.1.1.
evaluation_rubric: Diagnosis should identify resolv.conf or systemd-resolved as the likely cause, suggest 'cat /etc/resolv.conf' and 'systemctl status systemd-resolved', and propose adding a working nameserver.

name: Package Manager Repository Error
description: apt reports a missing or unreachable repository.
error_message:
E: Failed to fetch http://deb.debian.org/debian/dists/bookworm/InRelease  Connection failed [IP: 151.101.2.132 80]
E: Some index files failed to download. They have been ignored, or old ones used instead.
symptoms: apt update fails to fetch package lists. Previously worked fine.
expected_behavior: apt update should successfully refresh all repository indexes.
additional_context: Server is behind a corporate proxy.
evaluation_rubric: Diagnosis should mention proxy configuration (http_proxy env var or apt proxy settings), check sources.list validity, and test connectivity to the mirror.

name: Service Fails to Start
description: A systemd service enters failed state on start.
error_message:
Failed to start postgresql.service: Unit postgresql.service has entered the 'failed' state.
Job for postgresql.service failed because the control process exited with error code.
See 'systemctl status postgresql.service' and 'journalctl -xe' for details.
symptoms: PostgreSQL fails to start after server reboot. Was running fine before the reboot.
expected_behavior: PostgreSQL should start successfully and accept connections on port 5432.
attempted_actions: Tried systemctl restart postgresql. Same error.
additional_context: Data directory is /var/lib/pgsql/data. Last operation was a normal shutdown.
evaluation_rubric: Should recommend journalctl -u postgresql, check data directory permissions, and look for postgres log files in /var/lib/pgsql.

name: USB Device Not Detected
description: A USB drive is inserted but does not appear in the filesystem.
error_message: Device not showing in /dev or file manager. No mount point created.
symptoms: USB drive inserted but not detected. USB keyboard and mouse still work on other ports.
expected_behavior: USB drive should appear as /dev/sdX and be auto-mounted.
attempted_actions: Tried different USB port. Same result.
additional_context: USB 3.0 drive, inserting into USB 3.0 port.
evaluation_rubric: Diagnosis should recommend dmesg | grep -i usb, lsusb, and blkid to identify whether the kernel sees the device.

name: Permission Denied Error
description: User cannot access a file or directory due to permissions.
error_message:
bash: /opt/myapp/run.sh: Permission denied
bash: open("/var/log/myapp/app.log"): Permission denied
symptoms: Running the application script returns Permission denied. Application also cannot write to its log directory.
expected_behavior: User should be able to execute the script and the application should write logs.
attempted_actions: Verified the file exists at that path.
additional_context: Running as regular user 'alice'. Application was installed by root.
evaluation_rubric: Should suggest ls -l on the file and directory, check file ownership, and explain execute bit vs read bit. Should explain ACLs as an alternative to chmod 777.

name: Disk Space Exhaustion
description: System or application reports no space left on device.
error_message:
No space left on device
df: /: cannot write to /tmp: No space left on device
E: Problem renaming the file /var/cache/apt/pkgcache.bin.kLzBVR to /var/cache/apt/pkgcache.bin - PermissionDenied (28: No space left on device)
symptoms: System shows disk full errors. Applications are failing. apt cannot run.
expected_behavior: Sufficient disk space available for system operation.
additional_context: VPS with a 20GB root partition. Running for 2 years without cleanup.
evaluation_rubric: Should recommend df -h to confirm, du -sh /* to locate large directories, suggest clearing apt cache and journal logs as safe options, and explicitly warn against blindly deleting unknown large files.

name: Missing Shared Library
description: An application fails to start because a shared library is not found.
error_message: error while loading shared libraries: libssl.so.1.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
symptoms: Custom application binary fails to launch. Was working before a system upgrade.
expected_behavior: Application should launch and run normally.
attempted_actions: Tried running with sudo. Same error.
additional_context: Application was compiled against OpenSSL 1.1. System was upgraded to Ubuntu 22.04 which ships OpenSSL 3.
evaluation_rubric: Diagnosis should identify the OpenSSL version mismatch, suggest ldd to check dependencies, ldconfig -p to check cache, and recommend installing libssl1.1 compatibility package or recompiling.

name: Network Interface No Connectivity
description: A network interface has an IP address but no internet or LAN connectivity.
error_message:
connect: Network is unreachable
ping: connect: Network is unreachable
symptoms: Interface eth0 has an IP (192.168.1.50) but cannot ping gateway or internet. ifconfig shows interface up.
expected_behavior: Full network connectivity through eth0 to LAN and internet.
attempted_actions: Checked cable. Interface shows UP in ip link.
additional_context: Static IP configured. Gateway should be 192.168.1.1.
evaluation_rubric: Should recommend 'ip route show' to check for missing default route, verify gateway reachability, and check if static IP config has a gateway entry.
